target_subject: one illustrated person with dark hair and a red top, centered amid flowers

scene: A figure is surrounded by dense clusters of yellow and orange-red flowers against a black background.
Two large pink hearts flank the figure’s head—one on the left, one on the right—partially overlapping flowers.
The floral arrangement forms a near-complete frame around the upper torso and head of the figure.
action: The figure gazes slightly upward and to the viewer’s left with a neutral facial expression.
The figure remains stationary within the floral composition; no motion blur or dynamic posture is present.
Flowers are depicted in full bloom with visible green stems and leaves, suggesting a static botanical display.
rationale: The figure’s central placement and contrast with the dark background indicate intentional compositional focus.
The hearts’ symmetry and size relative to the figure suggest deliberate symbolic framing rather than accidental overlap.
The uniform petal shapes and color saturation imply stylized illustration, not photographic realism.
object: The figure has shoulder-length dark brown hair with bangs partially covering the forehead.
The figure wears a red off-the-shoulder top with a heart-shaped neckline.
The eyes are large and dark with white highlights; the left eye shows a small reflective glint.
The flowers are predominantly five-petaled with yellow petals and orange centers, interspersed with smaller orange-red blooms.
Two identical pink hearts appear as flat, opaque shapes with subtle shading, positioned at approximately eye level on either side of the head.
